claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Fermi 之後的申報寫出這批燃機交貨權／採購承諾被轉讓出去、取消，或改用電網／其他電源。核查頻率：每季（Fermi 季報）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀燃氣渦輪發電機組層的需求側。
claims.statement: Fermi 10-Q (Q2 2026): its first six Siemens SGT-800 gas turbines were acquired from MAD Energy, with Fermi assuming a net profits interest payable to MAD Energy — the units came via another holder rather than a new-build order. Reading this as a sign of slot scarcity is our inference; the filing does not say why.

sources.quote: In connection with the acquisition of the Company’s first six Siemens SGT-800 gas turbines from MAD Energy (the “Firebird Acquisition”), the Company assumed an obligation to pay MAD Energy a net profits interest (the “NPI”).
